user_review.method: Builder-operated tests with controlled browser fixtures and one real account; root operator supplied live receipts. Instruction behavior checked by explicitly simulated walkthrough. No independent user review.

scenarios.request: My account scan is running but I need to browse now.
scenarios.expected: Cards arrive progressively; search and notes remain usable; stop preserves arrived cards.
scenarios.observed: Controlled browser fixture streamed 20 then 60; search focus and unsaved note retained; stop kept arrived cards. Real first batch20 arrived in about6seconds; no timing guarantee.

scenarios.request: The source returned success but omitted pagination. Did I get everything?
scenarios.expected: Retain arrivals, mark incomplete; never infer completion from silence or success envelope alone.
scenarios.observed: 23 connector fixtures plus Node wire fixtures passed. Real v7 saw80 before a malformed source envelope; library retained295 unique cards. Final v8 stops source_response_incomplete in fixtures; no final real full scan or complete enumeration claim.

scenarios.request: I have retained cookies but verification failed. Must I scan QR again?
scenarios.expected: Retry existing session identity before requesting another login; timeout is not proof of signout.
scenarios.observed: Existing real session recovered without new QR; delayed hydration/identity Node fixtures and Python retry fixture passed. Anonymous QR3.77seconds was one observation.

scenarios.request: Summarize this supplied passage; no connector is installed.
scenarios.expected: Use supplied text; avoid invented source coverage or forced setup.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough uses passage directly, separates comments/video from caption and does not require connector installation.

similar_skills.learned: Check actual tools and login before source operations; source IDs/tokens must come from responses.
similar_skills.reason: Retain RedBot account checks and explicit scan/read separation; expose observed progress and coverage without implying source completion. Do not copy its blanket MCP-only fallback prohibition: user-supplied notes/backups remain useful.

similar_skills.learned: Separate per-account browser profiles; explicit NOT_LOGGED_IN recovery instead of assuming connector configuration is login.
similar_skills.reason: Retain isolated RedBot sessions, concrete expiry recovery and preservation of existing library. Reject automatic headed login fallback and publishing scope; RedBot remains read-only and GUI focus changes require user permission.

validation.command: Root builder browser trial and targeted Go/Node connector fixtures
validation.observed: Root reported Go targeted and both Node identity/wire fixture groups passed. Browser fixture20->60, stop retention, search/note focus. Actual390px Chrome width390/nooverflow. No physical-phone or two-real-account trial.

release_scope: 1.8 invitation-only account test; complete real-account enumeration unproven. Final v8 malformed-pagination handling fixture-tested, not followed by another full live scan. Temporary host, same-phone QR and two-real-account isolation remain limits.
